label: heroes
description: Balthazar tiger ringmaster hero sheet 4, run2 x 8 frames
original_prompt:
Generate a sprite sheet of 1 hero sprite for the hand-painted circus game "Petal Panic", continuing the exact same hand-painted circus style as the prior Balthazar sheets above.

LAYOUT: 1 row x 8 columns on a solid uniform pink background (rgb 250,152,170). The single row is one unique hero; the 8 columns are its 8 animation frames shown left-to-right. All cells exactly the same size (~221x445 px), evenly spaced, separated by thin light-pink grid lines (rgb 255,210,220, 2px wide). No text, no labels, no dark borders between cells. Image 1774 wide x 445 tall.

STYLE: hand-painted circus / big-top illustration. Soft painterly shading with visible brush texture, warm saturated colors, gentle highlights and shadows (not flat pixel art). Thick clean dark-brown/black outlines around the character. Side profile facing right. Consistent style across every frame.

ROW 1 (top to bottom), 8 distinct loopable frames — BALTHAZAR, an anthropomorphic orange-and-black striped tiger ringmaster wearing a black tuxedo suit (jacket + trousers) with a white dress shirt, red bow tie, and a red sash/belt at the waist; white-gloved hands; long striped tail streaming behind. A confident athletic RUN CYCLE (run2):
Frame 1 -> contact/foot down, body low, front leg bent forward, back leg pushing off.
Frame 2 -> passing through mid-stride, legs crossing, body rising slightly.
Frame 3 -> up position, both knees lifted, body at peak height, arms swinging.
Frame 4 -> opposite foot reaching forward, body beginning to lower.
Frame 5 -> second contact, other foot planted, body low again.
Frame 6 -> mid-stride mirror of frame 2, legs crossing the other way.
Frame 7 -> up position mirror of frame 3, knees lifted, body at peak.
Frame 8 -> return to the starting contact pose so the cycle loops seamlessly.

Frames within the row must be clearly distinct but smoothly sequential (loopable run). Keep it clean and croppable.
